table.name: documents
table.summary: A master table storing metadata and classification details for various documents, including their type, associated project, creation date, and descriptive names.

document_id.name: document_id
document_id.meaning: Unique identifier for each document record.

document_type_code.name: document_type_code
document_type_code.meaning: A short alphanumeric code representing the category or nature of the document (e.g., CV, BK).

project_id.name: project_id
project_id.meaning: Identifier linking the document to a specific project.

document_date.name: document_date
document_date.meaning: The timestamp when the document was created, updated, or processed.

document_name.name: document_name
document_name.meaning: A human-readable title or short name for the document.

document_description.name: document_description
document_description.meaning: A detailed textual description of the document content or purpose.

other_details.name: other_details
other_details.meaning: Additional miscellaneous information or notes about the document.

table.name: ref_budget_codes
table.summary: A reference table defining standard budget types with their corresponding codes and descriptions.

budget_type_code.name: budget_type_code
budget_type_code.meaning: A unique alphanumeric identifier representing a specific budget type.

budget_type_description.name: budget_type_description
budget_type_description.meaning: A human-readable text description explaining the meaning of the budget type code.

table.name: ref_document_types
table.summary: A reference table defining standard document types with their codes, names, and quality descriptions.

document_type_code.name: document_type_code
document_type_code.meaning: A unique alphanumeric identifier for a specific document type.

document_type_name.name: document_type_name
document_type_name.meaning: The human-readable name of the document type.

document_type_description.name: document_type_description
document_type_description.meaning: A qualitative assessment or description associated with the document type, seemingly indicating quality or sentiment.

table.name: documents_with_expenses
table.summary: A table linking specific documents to their associated budget types and descriptive categories.

document_id.name: document_id
document_id.meaning: A unique identifier for a specific document record.

budget_type_code.name: budget_type_code
budget_type_code.meaning: A short alphanumeric code representing the type of budget associated with the document.

document_details.name: document_details
document_details.meaning: A textual description or classification of the document, currently showing 'government' in samples.
